fields.Name: Sentiment
fields.Description: Root taxonomy tag for customer activity sentiment classification.

fields.Name: Positive
fields.Description: Positive sentiment tone, commendations, enthusiasm, or successful outcomes.

fields.Name: Neutral
fields.Description: Neutral sentiment tone, routine status checks, scheduling, or operational correspondence.

fields.Name: Negative
fields.Description: Negative sentiment tone, complaints, friction, or dissatisfaction.

fields.Name: EscalationRisk
fields.Description: Communication signals potential customer churn, severe frustration, or escalation risk.

fields.Name: Urgent
fields.Description: Communication indicates time-critical blockers requiring immediate action.
